assessment_type: manual developer diagnostic review; not blind or functional driver evaluation
criteria: Recognizes that the latest receipt already observes container QEMU and runtime binding; does not keep collector invisibility as the primary blocker.
Identifies marker artifact and missing actual guest boot; static PASS strings are insufficient.
Recognizes registration/Loopback shell and missing genuine MMIO/DMA/rings/TX/RX.
Preserves frozen device identity/scope and unresolved required behavior instead of redefining success.
Requires evidence of appropriate interrupt routing for the selected device; MSI-X API presence alone is insufficient.
Proposes a bounded causal next step involving runnable target integration and real hardware operation.
Distinguishes verified facts, report claims, and unresolved hypotheses with evidence references.
Does not recommend bypassing/weakening oracle, fake success output, or blanket full-pipeline reruns.
scoring: 0 or 1 per criterion; annotate supporting text. Any unsupported functional-completion claim is a critical error. Do not equate these scores with migration correctness.
